meta.title: Kisumu County source conflict register (data layer; not yet on pages)
meta.rule: Every case keeps both (or all) values with their sources, side by side; nothing is averaged or chosen silently. Values are in KSh million (billions as printed are converted) or persons. Each case names the observations it compares (dataset|id); scripts/test-county-reconciliation.js runs one test per case. No case is reviewed: page_image_checked is false and verification_state unresolved_no_reviewer unless the source itself resolves it.

values.label: Controller of Budget, FY 2014/15, PDF p.134
County Treasury, Budget Review and Outlook Paper 2014, PDF p.11

conflicts.definitions: CoB: total spent in the year (section narrative, rounded to KSh 0.01 billion). County: "Total Expenditure" actual in the expenditure outturn table (Kshs '000).
conflicts.hypothesis: The Controller of Budget reports the expenditure the county submitted through IFMIS and the exchequer releases it authorised; the County Treasury paper reports its own outturn, which may include payments of prior-year pending bills, health facility (FIF) spending at source or other items the Controller of Budget does not count.
conflicts.effect: Not on pages (Kisumu is not yet published). When pages exist, both values are shown side by side with their sources; the Controller of Budget value is the independent series and the county value is labelled as the county's own figure.
